newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa rebounds by close, coffee still down.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa rebounds by close, coffee still down.

text.p: COCOA - Bounces back to end tightly mixed as New York regains strength. May unchanged at 1,006 stg.
COFFEE - Still down as NY retains weaker tone. May/July switch active. May down $41 at $1,694 after failing to hold above $1,700.
SUGAR - Mixed in rangebound, trading. No news. May down 10 cents at $304.60 by 1702 GMT
